summary: Adds a transport-free AnalyzeService that loads trusted case facts, applies the existing privacy boundary, validates a candidate source trace, compiles server-owned commitments, builds accountability state, and optionally persists one normal-case snapshot.

Adds FactLoader with CaseSource/challenge selection, case relation checks, accepted no-PII declarations, ManifestImageResolver detail binding, and safe image-handle validation before provider extraction.
Preserves prior responsibility, manual fulfillment milestones, completed state, and audit history across normal-case reruns; challenge inputs neither load nor save a normal ledger.

tests_run.command: python -m pytest backend/tests/images/test_resolver.py backend/tests/privacy/test_sanitizer.py backend/tests/privacy/test_model_boundary.py backend/tests/model/test_extraction.py backend/tests/model/test_sources.py backend/tests/commitments/test_compiler.py backend/tests/state/test_builder.py -q

acceptance_results.criterion: An empty candidate conclusion still produces a schema-valid journey/state from trusted facts.
Normal reruns retain manual and completed fulfillment state and audit history.
Challenge copies are isolated from normal persistence.
Unknown input, provider unavailability, invalid candidate source, tampered image binding, and metrics failure have stable stop semantics.
Short isolated venv, dependency health, and no new third-party dependencies.

remaining_risks: This is implementation evidence only. Independent verification and integration acceptance remain separate owner actions.
The service intentionally has no HTTP transport or default live-provider wiring; callers must inject a CaseSource, image resolver, provider, ledger repository, and metrics sink.
Live provider deployment must continue to use a provider configured against the same accepted image resolver that supplied the validated handles.
handoff_notes: Use AnalyzeService.analyze for the frozen response projection, or analyze_with_trace for a redacted implementation trace.
Map AnalysisInputError, AnalysisModelUnavailable, AnalysisModelOutputError, and AnalysisInfrastructureError in the later transport layer while retaining request_id and retryable.
Do not reuse this venv for a later batch; create a new short isolated venv as required by that batch.
report_commit_resolution: A separate report-only commit follows the code commit so this report can record the immutable code SHA without a self-reference cycle.
